mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 20-day returns as the market anticipates accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated unemployment rates (UNRATE > 7.5%) signal economic weakness, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and producing negative S&P 500 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 7.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Joint declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 20-day returns due to reduced economic activity.
failure_condition: The joint decline of HOUST and RSAFS (both falling in the prior month) is not associated with negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, rising industrial production (INDPRO) reflects strong manufacturing activity, supporting corporate profits and generating positive S&P 500 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when the economy is in a late-cycle expansion and INDPRO is rising.

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment levels (PAYEMS) signal labor market strength, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 5-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS is rising.

mechanism_narrative: Falling industrial production (INDPRO < 95) indicates supply-side contraction, reducing output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 60-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 95.

mechanism_narrative: Declining housing starts (HOUST < 900) reflect a contracting residential sector, reducing construction activity and consumer confidence, which produces negative S&P 500 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST < 900.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2.5%) signal an easing monetary environment, compressing discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 20-day returns.
failure_condition: The joint signal of FEDFUNDS decline and CPIAUCSL < 2.5% is not associated with positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances.
